script:
for module in \
  prefect \
  prefect.client.schemas.objects \
  prefect.flows \
  prefect.deployments \
  prefect.events \
  prefect.server.api.server \
  prefect.task_runners \
; do
  /home/agent/.cache/uv/builds-v0/.tmp2mq4Ex/bin/python -m pytest "benches/bench_import.py::bench_import_module[$module]" \
    --benchmark-disable -vv -o 'filterwarnings='
done
/home/agent/.cache/uv/builds-v0/.tmp2mq4Ex/bin/python -m pytest benches/bench_import.py::bench_import_prefect_flow \
  --benchmark-disable -vv -o 'filterwarnings='
/home/agent/.cache/uv/builds-v0/.tmp2mq4Ex/bin/python -m pytest \
  benches/bench_tasks.py \
  benches/bench_flows.py::bench_flow_decorator \
  benches/bench_flows.py::bench_flow_call \
  --benchmark-disable \
  --numprocesses auto --maxprocesses 2 \
  --dist worksteal \
  -vv
